target.title: Add Claw manifest export command
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Claws now have a creation path, not only an apply/status/remove path. This PR adds `openclaw claws export` so a user can create a Claw manifest from selected local OpenClaw state and workspace files, with include/exclude controls that make starter setup authoring practical.

This stacks on the Claws RFC PR openclaw/rfcs#27 and the lifecycle stack, especially #102296.

## Summary

- Adds `claws export --id --name` with `--include`, `--exclude`, `--plugin`, `--workspace-file`, and `--persona` selection controls.
- Exports installed plugins from the installed plugin index into reusable artifact selectors.
- Writes self-contained file exports with sidecar `files/...` sources when `--out` is used, so the result can feed `claws apply` directly.
- Keeps plugin-only stdout export as raw manifest JSON for shell redirection.
- Rejects empty exports, requires `--out` for workspace/persona file exports, skips symlink escapes, skips oversized/non-regular files, deduplicates targets, and guarantees unique manifest entry ids.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/claws/schema.test.ts src/claws/provenance.test.ts src/claws/artifact-installers.test.ts src/claws/workspace.test.ts src/claws/lifecycle-state.test.ts src/state/openclaw-state-db.test.ts src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts src/cli/plugins-cli.uninstall.test.ts src/claws/lifecycle.e2e.test.ts src/cli/program/command-registry.test.ts src/cli/program/root-command-descriptions.test.ts`
- Real CLI proof: `claws export --out ... --include workspace,persona --workspace-file runbooks/incident.md --persona SOUL.md --json` followed by `claws apply <exported manifest> --workspace <target> --yes --json`; verified sidecar `files/...` and two applied workspace files.
- `git diff --check`
- `node scripts/check-no-conflict-markers.mjs`
- `codex review -c model=gpt-5.5 --uncommitted` reported no actionable correctness issues after fixes.

## Not Tested

- Full `pnpm exec tsgo --noEmit --pretty false` is still blocked by the existing unrelated `src/secrets/config-io.ts` TS4058 (`configWritePostCommitRollback` return type naming), outside this diff.
